text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with Mayano Top
Gun...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Маяно Топ Ган
is
pointing and see a claw machine filled
with
Umamusume plushies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look at those cuties! They're sooo
adorable! I
want one!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: But I've already spent my allowance...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган looks crestfallen, the
light
vanishing from her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Do you want me to win you one?

text_block_list.text:
You'd do that for me?! All right, then I'll
be your
own personal cheer squad!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Go, go! You can do it! Gooooo,
Trainerrrr! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
